_comment: Learning path of the math game (plan section 3): tiers, which tiers a floor may show, the rules that move a player between tiers and floors, and the time limit of every question type. Read through app/learning/math_path.py. Floors and micro-skills are in server/data/math/.

floor_tiers._comment: floor -> [lowest tier, highest tier] a question on that floor may have. Floor 10 is the optional hidden 'Tài Năng' floor.

adaptive._comment: Inside one session: this many right answers in a row raise the tier by one, this many wrong ones lower it by one, never outside the floor's range.

tier_unlock._comment: A tier-N question of a micro-skill appears only after this many right answers among the player's last `window` answers at tier N-1 of the same micro-skill. The floor's lowest tier is always open.

xp_per_correct._comment: Tu Vi for one right answer at tiers 1..5 in that order (a wrong answer or a timeout gives none).

mastery_gate._comment: To leave a floor: every micro-skill is already being asked at the highest tier of the floor and has at least min_correct_pct right among its last `window` answers at that tier, and the floor's own test is passed.

trial._comment: Thiên kiếp nhỏ, the test at the end of a floor: this many questions for each micro-skill of the floor, all at the floor's highest tier, with at most max_wrong of them missed. Every question keeps the time limit of its own type and tier; the trial has no clock of its own. It can be taken again straight away.

spiral_review._comment: Questions from the floors below the one being played: share_max of the questions asked are review questions (0.25 = every fourth one), which also keeps the share above share_min. A micro-skill comes back after intervals_days[streak] days, where streak is how many times in a row it was last answered right; the ones answered worst lately come first.

_template_cooldown: A template (a hand-written item or a generator) asked within the player's last this-many answers is passed over while another template is available.

parallel_question._comment: Rule 6 (tâm ma): after a wrong answer the same idea comes back with new numbers once this many other questions have been answered. At most max_open mistakes wait per player and floor; older ones are dropped.

bank_targets._comment: What a floor that has questions must have (checked by tools/check_all.py): templates (hand-written items + generators) and generators per floor, templates per micro-skill and tier, and how many different questions 200 draws of one generator must give.

placement_test._comment: Bài kiểm tra đầu vào (rule 7, app/systems/math_placement.py). per_floor questions for every written main floor, clamped to [min_questions, max_questions] in all (max_questions must cover one per main floor); a floor's bar is pass_pct of its questions right; the start floor is the lowest floor whose bar was not met (at most the last written floor) and the floors below it count as cleared. One sitting per subject: a result that skipped a floor is final; a result on the first floor (or an abandoned sitting) may be taken again after retake_after_days days (null = never).

programming._comment: Bài tập lập trình (M6). The learner's program runs on the learner's own machine, one run per test, with stdin in and stdout out; the server keeps the hidden tests' expected output and decides the verdict. time_limit_ms is the default per test, a problem may ask for more; tolerance is for problems graded as floats; reward is xp_per_correct at the problem's tier times the share of tests passed.

timeout._comment: Running out of time is a wrong answer and ends the combo; nothing else is lost.

question_types._comment: time_limit: seconds for tiers 1..5 in that order; null = this type does not exist at that tier.
